comments.text:
A subtle shift in Lash's demeanour when he's desperate. He'll stop gloating, and shift to being serious and threatening. He doesn't really have lines like "Oh yeah I'm awesome you suck lol" his lines go to "I'm not dead yet, and you're not safe until I am."

Also the closest lines he has to showing "doubt" is on some of his desperate flog lines. "Need'a second wind, come on." and "Come on Lash, you can out last em'."  and "Need'a land this." it's the only times he expresses any form of worry or doubt, and they're also noticeably quieter and mumbled to himself, cuz he doesn't wanna show weakness.
